name: print-social-infographic-teal-network-world-map
title: Teal social network infographic with world map and stat blocks
whatItIs: A dense teal-and-navy infographic combining a dotted world map with connection lines, colored percentage stat blocks, device icon rows, and a radar/diamond chart.
whatItMeans: A world map with connecting lines visually literalizes 'network' and 'global reach,' anchoring an otherwise abstract set of statistics in a spatial metaphor.
techniques: use a dotted world map with arcing connector lines to represent global/network scale
color-code stat blocks by section so a dense layout stays navigable
mix a radar/diamond chart alongside bar charts to avoid visual monotony in a stats-heavy piece

vocabulary.definition: a chart displaying multivariate data as points plotted on axes radiating from a center, connected into a polygon
